cases.situation: Our CRM implementation partner hasn't updated ticket #CR-3391 since Sept 19; we opened it on Sept 17 when lead routing broke after their last deploy. About 40 inbound leads a day land unassigned and we've sent error logs and a screen recording twice. I want to go to their account manager, Priya, directly.
cases.reply: Hi Priya, ticket #CR-3391 has been open since 17 September with no update since the 19th. Lead routing broke after the last deploy and about 40 inbound leads a day are landing unassigned. We've sent the error logs and a screen recording twice. Can you get a consultant assigned by end of day Thursday 8 October and confirm here? If that's not possible, I need to know now so we can route leads manually.
cases.note: Facts with dates, impact in numbers, what you've tried, one ask with a deadline.

cases.situation: 我们项目依赖另一个组的订单接口，对接的同事小刘一直说'快了快了'，已经拖了两周，下周五就要上线。我知道他手上排了好几件事。我打算找他们组长张组长，但想先跟小刘打个招呼。
cases.reply: 刘哥，先跟你说一声，免得你从别人那里听到：订单接口的事我今天会跟张组长提一下，主要是下周五就要上线了，时间实在压不住。不是针对你，我知道你手上排了好几件事。后面沟通我都会抄送你。
cases.note: 越级之前先打招呼，说清是时间问题不是人的问题，这是升级和背刺的区别。

cases.situation: I emailed my manager Tom twice (Sept 22 and 29) that our biggest client Delmar ($310k a year) wants a 6% discount to sign a three-year renewal, and the contract expires Oct 15. Legal needs a week for the paperwork. He hasn't replied, he's swamped with the merger. I've told Tom I'm going to his boss Anita now.
cases.reply:
Subject: Decision needed by Wed 7 Oct: Delmar renewal pricing
Hi Anita, I raised the Delmar renewal with Tom on 22 and 29 September, and I know the merger has him stretched. Delmar's contract ($310k a year) expires 15 October and they've asked for a 6% discount to sign a three-year term. I need a yes or no on the 6% by Wednesday 7 October so legal has a week to turn the paperwork before it expires. My recommendation: approve it, since three years locks in our biggest client. Tom knows I'm writing to you and is copied.
cases.note: Say you tried the manager first, copy him, keep it under 150 words, and close with your recommendation.

cases.situation: Mein Internet ist seit dem 10. September komplett weg, ich arbeite im Homeoffice (Kundennummer 4471 2290). Zwei Störungsmeldungen (Tickets 88120 und 88341), der Technikertermin am 22. ist ohne Nachricht ausgefallen. Ich will jetzt eine Beschwerde, die wirklich weitergeleitet wird, und wenn nichts passiert, gehe ich zur Schlichtungsstelle der Bundesnetzagentur. Ich heiße Sabine Krause.
cases.reply:
Betreff: Dritte Meldung, Anschluss seit 10. September ausgefallen, Kundennummer 4471 2290
Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren,
dies ist meine dritte Meldung zum Ausfall meines Internetanschlusses seit dem 10. September. Bisherige Ticketnummern: 88120 und 88341. Der Technikertermin am 22. September wurde ohne Nachricht nicht wahrgenommen. Ich arbeite von zu Hause und bin seit drei Wochen auf mobile Daten angewiesen. Bitte leiten Sie den Fall an Ihr Beschwerdemanagement weiter und bestätigen Sie mir bis Mittwoch, 7. Oktober, einen verbindlichen Technikertermin. Andernfalls wende ich mich an die Schlichtungsstelle der Bundesnetzagentur.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Sabine Krause
cases.note: Ticketnummern und Daten statt Adjektive, eine Bitte mit Frist, und nur einen nächsten Schritt ankündigen, den man auch wirklich geht. Ob die Schlichtungsstelle zuständig ist, vorher bei ihr prüfen.

cases.situation: I escalated to my director Paul that our Quantix data contract lapses Oct 15 and legal needs to review the renewal, which takes them two days. He replied 'not a priority this week, Q4 planning first.' If it lapses, the trading desk loses its daily pricing feed.
cases.reply: Understood, Q4 planning comes first this week. So I can plan: if legal hasn't reviewed the Quantix renewal by Tuesday 13 October, the contract lapses on the 15th and the trading desk loses its daily pricing feed. Can you confirm in writing that we're accepting that risk, or tell me who else can approve legal's time? I want to make sure it's a decision and not a default.
cases.note: When they say it isn't a priority, don't argue: restate the dated consequence and ask for the risk to be accepted in writing, or for another decision-maker.

cases.situation: I run a small agency rebuilding a client's website. Their marketing lead, Josh, owes us the product copy and photos for 40 pages, due Sept 8, and launch is Nov 2. We've spoken three times since and he keeps saying 'this week'. I told Josh yesterday I'd raise the timeline with their COO, Linda. We could launch Nov 2 with the 15 core pages and add the rest by Nov 20, or move launch to Nov 16. Now the email to her.
cases.reply:
Subject: Decision needed by Tue 6 Oct: website launch date

Hi Linda, the 2 November launch is at risk. We still need the product copy and photos for 40 pages, originally due 8 September. Josh and I have spoken three times since, and he knows I'm raising the timeline with you. Two options: launch on the 2nd with the 15 core pages and add the rest by 20 November, or move launch to Monday 16 November. I recommend the phased launch, and we'd need the core page content by Friday 9 October. Could you let me know which by Tuesday 6 October?
cases.note: Escalating to a client's sponsor is about the date, not Josh: say he knows, give two options and a recommendation.

cases.situation: 我是一家电商公司的运维。我们用的云服务商从9月27日起生产环境间歇性报502，大概3%的请求失败，用户在结账页面直接报错。工单CS-20931开了三天，一线只让我们清缓存、重启实例，两样都做过了，我们有能复现问题的curl命令。想直接要求升级到二线技术支持。
cases.reply: 您好，工单CS-20931申请升级到二线技术支持。问题：9月27日起，我们的生产环境间歇性返回502，约3%的请求失败，可用下方的curl命令复现。影响：用户在结账页面直接报错，影响成交。已尝试：按一线建议清过缓存、重启过实例，问题依旧。请今天内指派一位负责工程师，并告知首次响应的预计时间。
cases.note: 技术类升级：现象、比例、复现方式、影响和已试过的步骤写清，只要一个负责人和一个响应时间，不评价一线客服。

cases.situation: I sent my teammate Marcus a heads-up, then escalated our stuck data migration to our manager Helen because the client cutover is Oct 16. Helen reassigned part of it. Now Marcus messaged me: 'Could've just talked to me instead of going to Helen.'
cases.reply: I hear that it landed badly, and I'm sorry it felt like going around you. I sent you the note first because I didn't want you blindsided, but I can see a message isn't the same as a conversation. The date was what worried me, not your work. I'd rather sort things out with you than around you. Can we grab ten minutes today at 3?
cases.note: When the person you went past is upset, don't defend the escalation; acknowledge it, restate that it was about the date, and ask to talk.

cases.situation: On Sept 22 I escalated to Hannah, the regional manager at our letting agency, because the boiler at our flat (Flat 3, 14 Carlow Road) has been out since Sept 14 and the maintenance line kept saying 'booked in'. I asked for a repair date by Friday. Nothing back. I have a two-year-old and it's getting cold at night. If this goes nowhere I'll contact the council's private housing team.
cases.reply: Hi Hannah, following up on my email of 22 September: the Friday deadline has passed and I haven't had a reply. The boiler at Flat 3, 14 Carlow Road has now been out for more than two weeks, and the nights are getting cold with a two-year-old in the flat. Are you the right person to book the repair, or should I take it to someone else? Either answer helps. If I don't have a repair date by Tuesday 6 October, I'll contact the council's private housing team.
cases.note: An ignored escalation: reply on the same thread, restate the facts and the one ask, and only name a next step you'll actually take. If the cold affects your child's health, call your doctor, and check with the council what repair times apply.

cases.situation: Two weeks ago I escalated our invoice rounding bug to my director Aisha, after sending a heads-up to Kenji on the platform team, who owned it and had already traced it to the currency conversion before I escalated. It sat in his queue behind other work. Aisha got it prioritised, Kenji's fix shipped yesterday, and she's confirmed the October billing run on Monday the 5th is clear. I want to close the loop with him.
cases.reply: Kenji, update: the rounding fix went out yesterday, and Aisha has confirmed the October billing run on Monday the 5th is clear. I've told her the diagnosis was yours; you'd found the currency conversion bug before it ever reached her. Thanks for sticking with it while it sat in your queue.
cases.note: Closing the loop with the person you went past: the outcome, and the credit where the work was done, so the escalation doesn't read as a takeover.

cases.situation: Trabajo en el turno de mañana de un almacén en Getafe (soy Andrés Molina). La carretilla elevadora número 3 tiene el freno de mano fallando desde el 15 de septiembre: en la rampa del muelle 2 se desplaza con carga. Se lo dije al jefe de turno, Raúl, el 15 y el 22, mantenimiento no la ha revisado y la siguen usando; la carretilla 5 está libre por las tardes. Ya le he avisado a Raúl de que escribo a la jefa de planta, Elena.
cases.reply:
Asunto: Decisión necesaria hoy: carretilla 3 con el freno de mano averiado
Hola, Elena: la carretilla elevadora número 3 tiene el freno de mano fallando desde el 15 de septiembre; en la rampa del muelle 2 se desplaza con carga. Se lo comuniqué a Raúl el 15 y el 22, mantenimiento aún no la ha revisado y se sigue usando en todos los turnos. Raúl sabe que te escribo. Te pido que la retires del servicio hoy hasta que mantenimiento confirme que es segura. Mi recomendación: etiquetarla como fuera de servicio y cubrir su trabajo con la carretilla 5, que está libre por las tardes.
Gracias,
Andrés Molina, turno de mañana
cases.note: Con un riesgo de seguridad el plazo es hoy: hechos con fechas, lo ya intentado y una sola petición. Si no hay respuesta, el siguiente paso es el delegado de prevención y, si sigue en uso, consultar con la Inspección de Trabajo.

cases.situation: Freelance illustrator, Jo Park. Invoice #1042 for $3,800 to Harlow Books, for the spring list cover illustrations, was due Aug 28 under the 30-day terms in our contract. I emailed their accounts payable on Sept 1, 10 and 21 with no reply, and my art director Megan Doyle says she chased finance on Sept 15. I've told Megan I'm writing to their head of finance, Paul Grant, today.
cases.reply:
Subject: Payment date needed by Fri 9 Oct: invoice #1042
Hi Paul, invoice #1042 for $3,800 (cover illustrations for the spring list) was due on 28 August under the 30-day terms in our contract. I emailed accounts payable on 1, 10 and 21 September with no reply, and Megan Doyle kindly chased internally on 15 September. It is now 35 days overdue. Could you confirm a payment date, or tell me who can, by Friday 9 October? The simplest fix is a bank transfer to the details on the attached invoice. Megan is copied. Thanks, Jo Park
cases.note: Money owed by a client: facts and dates only, one ask with a deadline, and the heads-up to your friendly contact goes first.

cases.situation: 我是7号楼1502的周晴。我们小区7号楼唯一的电梯9月20日坏了，到现在还没修。楼里有三户八十多岁的老人，其中1103的张阿姨每周要去医院透析两次，现在只能靠家人背下楼。物业前台两次都说“在等配件”。我想代表五户邻居写给物业经理李经理，让事情真正动起来。
cases.reply: 李经理您好，我是7号楼1502的住户周晴，代表楼里五户邻居写这条消息。7号楼唯一的电梯从9月20日停到今天，前台两次答复都是“等配件”，没有维修日期。楼里有三位八十多岁的老人，其中1103的张阿姨每周要去医院透析两次，现在只能靠家人背下楼。麻烦您在10月6日前告诉我们：配件预计哪天到、哪天能修好，以及修好之前能否安排人手协助老人上下楼。谢谢您。
cases.note: 代表多户升级时，写清你代表谁、影响最大的具体的人和一个带日期的问题；再没回应，下一步可以联系业委会或街道。老人身体不适需要就医时直接打120，不要等电梯修好。

cases.situation: I'm Maya Singh (student ID 20241187). My spring grade for STAT 301 still shows 'incomplete' though I submitted the final project through the course portal on May 10, and I have the receipt. My scholarship renewal needs a complete transcript by Friday Oct 16. I emailed the TA, Ben Carter, on Sept 8 and 21 and Professor Ortiz on Sept 24, no replies. I've told Professor Ortiz I'm writing to the undergraduate director, Dr. Lang.
cases.reply:
Subject: Grade needed by Fri 9 Oct: STAT 301 incomplete, scholarship deadline
Dear Dr. Lang, my spring grade for STAT 301 (Professor Ortiz) still shows as incomplete, although I submitted the final project through the course portal on 10 May (receipt attached). My scholarship renewal needs a complete transcript by Friday 16 October. I emailed the TA, Ben Carter, on 8 and 21 September and Professor Ortiz on 24 September, and haven't had a reply; Professor Ortiz knows I'm writing to you and is copied. Could you help get the grade entered, or tell me who can, by Friday 9 October, so the registrar has a week to update the transcript? Thank you, Maya Singh, student ID 20241187
cases.note: Academic escalation: the ask date sits a week before the real deadline, and the professor gets the heads-up and a copy, so it reads as a timeline problem, not a complaint.

cases.situation: 我是陈静，儿子陈小宇上三（2）班。9月14日和9月23日两次跟班主任赵老师反映他在课间被同班一个男生推倒，第二次膝盖擦破了。赵老师说会处理，但儿子说这周还在发生，现在不太想去学校了。国庆假期后10月9日开学。我已经跟赵老师说了要找年级组长孙老师，现在要给孙老师发消息。
cases.reply: 孙老师您好，我是三（2）班陈小宇的家长陈静。想请您帮忙跟进一件事：9月14日和9月23日，我两次向赵老师反映小宇课间被同班一位同学推倒，第二次膝盖擦破了；赵老师很重视，说会处理，但小宇这周说还在发生。我担心的是他的安全，现在他已经不太想去学校了。能否在10月9日开学后一周内，约我和赵老师一起见面谈一次，定下课间怎么看护？我已经跟赵老师说过会联系您，这不是对赵老师有意见，只是希望多一个人帮忙把这件事落实。
cases.note: 涉及孩子安全，照样先跟班主任打招呼、只写事实和日期；如果有受伤或持续发生，保留照片和记录；学校仍不改善时，可以向当地教育部门反映，孩子情绪持续低落就找学校心理老师或医生。

cases.situation: 我是运营部的林晓，9月份加了22小时的班，都在考勤系统里审批过了，我有审批截图，但9月工资条上加班费是0。9月25号跟直属领导周经理说了，他让我找人事；9月28号我发邮件给人事专员小何，到现在没回。我已经跟小何说了会去找人事经理吴经理。
cases.reply: 吴经理您好，我是运营部的林晓，想请您帮忙处理一笔工资的问题。我9月共加班22小时，都已在考勤系统审批通过（截图附后），但9月工资条上的加班费是0。9月25日我向周经理反映过，他建议我找人事；9月28日我发邮件给何专员，目前还没有回复，我也已经跟她说了会联系您。麻烦您在10月12日（周一）前帮我确认这笔加班费是否漏算，以及哪天可以补发。谢谢您！
cases.note: 工资类升级只写小时数、审批记录和已经找过谁；加班费怎么算以劳动合同和公司制度为准，第一封里先不提仲裁。

cases.situation: I'm a customer success manager. Since Sept 21, appointment reminders for our client Brightline Dental have been failing to send, about 30 patients a day (ticket ENG-4412); the assigned engineer, Sam, has it in the backlog behind the Oct 20 release. Their ops lead, Nora, says they'll start looking at other vendors if it isn't fixed by Oct 15, and they renew on Oct 31 at $48k a year. I told Sam yesterday I'm taking it to his manager, Rita, and I need her answer by Tuesday Oct 6 so I can give Nora a date.
cases.reply:
Subject: Decision needed by Tue Oct 6: priority for ENG-4412 (Brightline Dental)

Hi Rita, since Sept 21 Brightline Dental's appointment reminders have been failing to send, about 30 patients a day (ENG-4412). It's in Sam's backlog behind the Oct 20 release, and I've told him I'm raising the priority with you. Their ops lead, Nora, says they'll start looking at other vendors if it isn't fixed by Oct 15, and they renew on Oct 31 at $48k a year. Could you decide by Tuesday whether ENG-4412 moves ahead of the release work? I'd recommend yes, so I can give Nora a fix date.
cases.note: Internal escalation on a customer's behalf: the email is about a priority call Rita owns, not about Sam, and says Sam already knows.

cases.situation: I'm Ellen Hale. My mum, Margaret Hale (hospital number 448210), was told on Aug 20 she'd get a cardiology appointment within six weeks. I called the booking office on Sept 8 and Sept 22 and both times was told the referral is 'on the system' but there's no date. Her chest pains are getting more frequent and her GP said on Monday she needs to be seen soon. I'm emailing the hospital's patient liaison team.
cases.reply:
Subject: Cardiology appointment needed by 7 Oct: referral from 20 August, no date yet
Dear Patient Liaison team, I'm writing about my mother, Margaret Hale, hospital number 448210. On 20 August she was told she'd get a cardiology appointment within six weeks. I called the booking office on 8 and 22 September and both times was told the referral is on the system, with no date. Her chest pains are getting more frequent, and her GP said on Monday that she needs to be seen soon. Could you confirm an appointment date, or who is handling the referral, by Wednesday 7 October? Thank you, Ellen Hale
cases.note: If her chest pain worsens or comes on at rest, call emergency services now; this email is for the waiting list, not an emergency.

cases.situation: I'm the only data analyst on our team. Two directors both need a big piece of work from me by Friday Oct 9: Priya wants the churn analysis for the board deck, Owen wants the pricing model for the Hartley renewal. Each is about 3 days of work, so I can only finish one. I've told both of them I'm taking it to our manager Dana to decide.
cases.reply: Hi Dana, I need a priority call from you by Monday 5 October at noon. Priya needs the churn analysis for the board deck and Owen needs the pricing model for the Hartley renewal, both by Friday Oct 9, and each is about 3 days of work, so I can finish one. I've told them both I'm bringing it to you. Could you decide which comes first? My recommendation is the Hartley model, since the renewal date can't move, and I can give Priya a one-page churn summary for the board deck instead.
cases.note: When two people with equal power disagree, escalate the choice, not the people, and tell both before you do.

cases.situation: 我是客服组的周敏。周一（9月28日）我发现公司共享盘里有个文件夹设成了“任何人凭链接可查看”，里面有大约400份客户的身份证扫描件。当天就告诉了负责共享盘的IT同事老韩，他说会改，到今天下午还是公开的。我已经跟老韩说了要去找信息安全负责人何经理。
cases.reply:
标题：今天下班前需要处理：共享盘客户身份证文件夹仍可公开访问
何经理您好，我是客服组的周敏。9月28日周一我发现共享盘里有个文件夹设成了“任何人凭链接可查看”，里面约有400份客户身份证扫描件。当天我告诉了负责共享盘的老韩，他说会改，但截至今天下午仍然是公开的，我也跟他说了会来找您。链接多开放一天，客户信息外泄的风险就多一天。能否请您今天下班前安排关闭公开权限？我的建议是先改成仅内部可见，再查一下有没有被外部访问过。
cases.note: 涉及客户个人信息，截止时间按小时算；是否需要上报或通知客户，交给公司的安全和法务判断。

cases.situation: I'm Mia Torres, in a four-person group for MKT 210; our final report is due Friday Oct 23 and is worth 30% of the grade. Our teammate Jordan hasn't sent his section, the competitor analysis, which was due Sept 25; he missed our meetings on Sept 22 and 29 and hasn't answered our messages from Sept 26 and 29. I told him today that I'm emailing Professor Adler to ask how to handle it.
cases.reply:
Subject: Guidance needed by Fri 9 Oct: MKT 210 group report
Dear Professor Adler, I'm writing about our group's final report for MKT 210, due Friday 23 October. Our teammate Jordan hasn't sent his section, the competitor analysis, which was due on 25 September; he missed our meetings on 22 and 29 September and hasn't replied to our messages on 26 and 29 September. Jordan knows I'm writing to you. Could you let us know by Friday 9 October how you'd like us to handle it? Our suggestion is that the other three of us split the section and each member submits a short note on what they contributed. Thank you, Mia Torres
cases.note: Group-project escalation: dates instead of judgements about Jordan, and a proposed fix so the professor only has to say yes.

cases.situation: I'm Tomás Rivera, a software engineer transferring to our London office from Monday 2 November. My visa appointment is Thursday 15 October and I need an employment verification letter from HR for it: I requested it through the HR portal on 14 September (ticket HR-5520), chased on 23 September, and my manager Grace chased on 25 September, and it still says 'in queue'. If I miss the appointment the next slot is in January, which would push back my start in London, and I've told the HR generalist, Priya, that I'm writing to the HR director, Mark Allen.
cases.reply:
Subject: Letter needed by Fri 9 Oct: employment verification for visa (HR-5520)

Hi Mark, I need an employment verification letter for my visa appointment on Thursday 15 October, ahead of my transfer to the London office on Monday 2 November. I requested it through the HR portal on 14 September (ticket HR-5520) and chased on 23 September, and my manager, Grace, chased on 25 September; it still shows 'in queue'. If I miss the appointment, the next slot is in January, which would push back my start in London. Could you get the letter to me by Friday 9 October, or tell me who can sign it? Priya knows I'm writing to you. Thanks, Tomás
cases.note: The deadline is a week before the appointment so there's time to fix a wrong letter; one ask, with an easy alternative.

cases.situation: I'm Nadia Rahman and I own Hearth Bakery. Our flour supplier, Fennick Mills, delivered 30 of the 40 sacks we ordered on Sept 7, 17 and 28; each time I raised it with our account rep, Dan, who said it was a warehouse issue. Buying flour retail to cover the gaps has cost us about $260 extra so far, our Christmas orders start in November, and the next delivery is Thursday Oct 8. I've told Dan I'm writing to his sales director, Karen Wu.
cases.reply:
Subject: Confirmation needed by Mon 5 Oct: full flour delivery on 8 Oct

Hi Karen, our last three deliveries came short: on 7, 17 and 28 September we received 30 of the 40 sacks we ordered. Covering the gaps with retail flour has cost us about $260 so far, and our Christmas orders start in November. I raised each shortfall with Dan, who put it down to a warehouse issue, and I've let him know I'm writing to you. I need you to confirm by Monday 5 October that our delivery on Thursday 8 October will be the full 40 sacks. My recommendation: have someone check our order against the docket before it leaves the warehouse.

Thanks,
Nadia Rahman, Hearth Bakery
cases.note: One ask only; raise the $260 credit separately once deliveries are fixed.

cases.situation: 我是赵琳。我爸赵建国住在一家养老院的302房，卧床，需要每两小时翻一次身。9月20日和9月27日我两次跟护理组长小郑反映，探望时发现他三四个小时没人翻身，背上已经发红；小郑说会加强，但这周护工还是说人手不够。我已经跟小郑说了要找孙院长。
cases.reply: 孙院长您好，我是302房赵建国的女儿赵琳。我爸卧床，需要每两小时翻一次身。9月20日和9月27日，我两次向护理组长小郑反映，探望时发现他三四个小时没人翻身，背上已经发红；小郑说会加强，但这周护工还是说人手不够。我已经跟小郑说了会联系您，这不是针对小郑个人。麻烦您在10月3日（周六）前回复我：能否从现在起保证每两小时给我爸翻一次身，并留下翻身记录，我探望时可以看。谢谢您。
cases.note: 背上发红可能是压疮的早期迹象，请尽快让医生或护士检查；如果皮肤破了或他发烧，直接就医，不要等回复。院方仍不改善的话，可以向当地民政部门反映。

cases.situation: I'm Dana Okafor, opening a bakery at 41 Mill Lane. Our building permit application (ref BP-26-0912) went in on 3 August and the council's planning office said to expect a decision in four to six weeks. I emailed the assigned officer, Mr. Grant, on 15 and 24 September with no reply. Our contractor's crew is booked to start on 19 October and our contract with them charges £400 a day if we hold them. I've told Mr. Grant I'm writing to his team manager, Ms. Hollis.
cases.reply:
Subject: Decision date needed by Wed 7 Oct: permit BP-26-0912, 41 Mill Lane
Dear Ms. Hollis, our building permit application for 41 Mill Lane (ref BP-26-0912) went in on 3 August, and we were told to expect a decision in four to six weeks; it has now been more than eight. I emailed Mr. Grant on 15 and 24 September and haven't had a reply, and he knows I'm writing to you. Our contractor's crew is booked to start on 19 October and charges £400 a day if we hold them. Could you confirm the status and an expected decision date by Wednesday 7 October, or tell me who can? If anything is missing from the application, let me know and I'll send it within one working day.
Kind regards,
Dana Okafor
cases.note: With a public office, ask for a status and a date, not a yes; the cost of waiting is a fact, not a threat.

cases.situation: I'm Hana Brooks, getting married at Willowmere Barn on Saturday 24 October. Our coordinator there, Chloe, hasn't answered my emails of 14 and 25 September asking for the final floor plan and confirmation that the 12 vegetarian meals are on the catering order, and the caterer needs final numbers by Friday 9 October. I left Chloe a voicemail yesterday saying I'd contact the venue manager, Greg Moss.
cases.reply:
Subject: Confirmation needed by Wed 7 Oct: Brooks wedding, 24 October
Hi Greg, our wedding is at Willowmere Barn on Saturday 24 October. I emailed Chloe on 14 and 25 September asking for the final floor plan and confirmation that our 12 vegetarian meals are on the catering order, and haven't had a reply; I let her know yesterday that I'd be in touch with you. The caterer needs final numbers by Friday 9 October. Could you send the floor plan and confirm the vegetarian meals by Wednesday 7 October, or tell me who's handling our booking now? Thanks, Hana Brooks
cases.note: A personal event with a hard date: the ask lands two days before the caterer's cutoff, and Chloe hears it from you first.

cases.situation: 派遣社員の山本恵です。派遣先で、契約書の業務内容にない電話対応を9月から毎日2時間ほど任されていて、本来のデータ入力が終わらず9月の残業は15時間になりました。派遣元の営業担当の田中さんに9月10日と24日に伝え、契約書の業務内容も見せましたが「確認します」のままです。田中さんには上長の小林課長に連絡すると伝えてあり、10月15日の更新面談より前に方針を決めてほしいです。
cases.reply:
件名：10月9日（金）までにご判断のお願い：派遣先での契約外の業務について
小林課長
お世話になっております。派遣社員の山本恵です。派遣先にて、9月から毎日2時間ほど電話対応を任されていますが、契約書の業務内容には含まれておりません。そのため本来のデータ入力が終わらず、9月の残業は15時間になりました。9月10日と24日に田中さんにご相談し、契約書の業務内容もお見せしましたが、まだ方針が決まっていない状況です。田中さんには、小林課長にご連絡することをお伝えしております。10月15日の更新面談の前に、派遣先とご確認のうえ、10月9日（金）までに方針をお知らせいただけますでしょうか。私としては、契約書どおりの業務に戻していただくか、電話対応を続ける場合は契約内容を見直していただくのがよいと考えております。
よろしくお願いいたします。
山本恵
cases.note: 派遣の三者関係でも形は同じ。契約外かどうかは一般論で断定せず、契約書の記載に結びつけて伝える。

cases.situation: I'm Ruth Adler. Ashgrove Renovations is redoing our bathroom, and since the tiler left on Sept 18 the new shower valve has been dripping into the kitchen ceiling below, which now has a brown stain the size of a dinner plate. I told the site foreman, Kev, on Sept 21 and Sept 28 with photos, and both times he said a plumber would come 'this week', but nobody has. The contract says the job finishes Oct 9, and I've told Kev I'm emailing the owner, Martin Ash, today.
cases.reply:
Subject: Plumber needed by Tue 6 Oct: leak from new shower valve

Hi Martin,
I've let Kev know I'm writing to you. Since the tiler left on 18 September, the new shower valve in our bathroom has been dripping into the kitchen ceiling below, and there's now a stain the size of a dinner plate. I reported it to Kev with photos on 21 and 28 September, and both times a plumber was due 'this week', but nobody has come. The damage grows every day it runs, and the job is due to finish on 9 October. Can you get a plumber to us by Tuesday 6 October and confirm the visit time by reply? Photos attached.
Thanks,
Ruth Adler
cases.note: A homeowner escalating past a site foreman: heads-up first, dated facts, the damage as impact, one visit by one date. If water reaches light fittings or the ceiling sags, turn off the water and power there and call an emergency plumber or electrician first.

cases.situation: I'm Owen Price. My health insurer, Clearpath Mutual, pre-authorised my knee MRI on 2 September (authorisation ref PA-77310), and I had the scan on 10 September. They've denied the $1,450 claim twice, on 18 and 28 September, as 'not authorised'; I called on 21 and 29 September and was told it would be reviewed, with nothing since. The imaging centre says the bill goes to collections if it's unpaid by 20 October, and I want to escalate to a claims supervisor.
cases.reply:
Subject: Correction needed by Fri 9 Oct: denied claim for pre-authorised MRI (PA-77310)
Dear Claims Supervisor, I'm asking for my claim for a knee MRI on 10 September to be escalated. The scan was pre-authorised on 2 September (authorisation ref PA-77310, letter attached), but the $1,450 claim was denied on 18 and 28 September as not authorised. I called on 21 and 29 September and was told it would be reviewed, and I haven't heard anything since. The imaging centre will send the bill to collections if it is unpaid by 20 October. Could you reprocess the claim against PA-77310, or confirm in writing who is handling it, by Friday 9 October? Thank you, Owen Price
cases.note: Keep every call reference, and check your policy for the formal appeal route and its deadline in case this doesn't fix it.

cases.situation: I'm Kofi Mensah, in room 512 at the Saltmarsh Hotel with three more nights booked. The air conditioning broke last night and the room was 29°C at midnight; I reported it at 11pm and again at 7am, and both times the front desk said maintenance would come 'later today' with no time. I want to write to the duty manager through the hotel app and get it repaired or get moved by 6pm today.
cases.reply: Hi, this is Kofi Mensah in room 512. The air conditioning stopped working last night, the room was 29°C at midnight, and I have three more nights booked. I reported it to the front desk at 11pm and again at 7am, and both times was told maintenance would come later today, with no time given. Could you either have it repaired or move me to a room with working air conditioning by 6pm today, and confirm here which it will be? My preference is a room move, so neither of us is relying on a same-day repair.
cases.note: Same shape as any escalation: facts with times, impact, what you've tried, one decision with a deadline, and no blame on the front desk.

cases.situation: I'm Leo Grant, a second-year PhD student. My ethics application for my classroom interview study has been with my supervisor, Dr Harmon, for sign-off since 24 August; I reminded him on 9 and 21 September. The committee's deadline for its 14 October meeting is 7 October, the next meeting is in December, and our partner school can only host interviews until 30 November, so I've told Dr Harmon I'm asking the graduate director, Dr Okoye, for help and I'll copy him in.
cases.reply:
Subject: Sign-off needed by Wed 7 Oct: ethics application
Dear Dr Okoye, my ethics application for my classroom interview study has been with Dr Harmon for sign-off since 24 August, and I reminded him on 9 and 21 September. The committee's deadline for its 14 October meeting is 7 October; the next meeting is in December, after our partner school's interview window closes on 30 November, so missing this one means losing the fieldwork. Dr Harmon knows I'm writing and is copied. Could you help me get his sign-off, or tell me who else can sign, before 7 October?
cases.note: Academic skip-level: the supervisor is told first and copied, and the ask leaves him room to sign himself.

cases.situation: Sou a Carla Mendes, desenvolvedora freelancer do app de fidelidade da rede de farmácias Bem Viver. Preciso que o cliente aprove o teste de aceitação da versão 2.3 até quarta-feira, 7 de outubro, para publicar o app antes da campanha de 15 de outubro; enviei o relatório de testes à gerente do projeto, Inês, em 28 de setembro, mas ela está de licença até 19 de outubro e a resposta automática não indica substituto. Vou escrever para o diretor dela, Rogério Lima, com a Inês em cópia.
cases.reply:
Assunto: Aprovação necessária até quarta, 7 de outubro: versão 2.3 do app Bem Viver
Olá, Rogério, a Inês está de licença até 19 de outubro e a resposta automática dela não indica substituto, por isso escrevo diretamente a você; ela está em cópia para ver isto quando voltar. Enviei a ela o relatório de testes da versão 2.3 em 28 de setembro e ainda falta a aprovação do teste de aceitação. Para publicar o app antes da campanha de 15 de outubro, preciso dessa aprovação até quarta-feira, 7 de outubro. Você pode aprovar ou indicar quem responde pelo projeto enquanto ela está fora? Minha sugestão é indicar alguém para validar o relatório, que já está pronto.
Obrigada,
Carla Mendes
cases.note: Quando não dá para avisar a pessoa antes, diga por quê e deixe-a em cópia; o pedido é uma decisão ou um nome, não uma reclamação.

cases.situation: 我叫吴婷。9月25日在购物平台上的“清风家电旗舰店”买了一台1899元的空气净化器，订单号20260925-7731，到货时外壳就是裂的，我有完整的开箱视频。店铺客服9月26日同意退货，我9月27日寄回，对方9月30日签收后却说是“人为损坏”，拒绝退款。我已经在聊天里跟店铺客服说了会申请平台介入，现在要写申请说明。
cases.reply:
您好，我申请平台介入订单20260925-7731（清风家电旗舰店，空气净化器，1899元）。9月25日下单，到货时外壳已开裂，我有完整的开箱视频。9月26日店铺客服同意退货，我9月27日寄回，商家9月30日签收后以“人为损坏”为由拒绝退款。我已在聊天中告知店铺客服会申请平台介入。开箱视频和聊天记录截图附后。请平台核实后支持全额退款1899元，并告知处理时限。谢谢。
吴婷
cases.note: 向平台申诉也按升级的写法：订单号、日期、证据和一个请求；具体规则和时限以平台说明为准，开箱视频原件别删。

cases.situation: I run the data pipeline at a small logistics firm, and we rely on Larkspur, an open-source CSV library. On 8 September I opened pull request #612 fixing a crash on files with an empty header row, which hits about 30 of our nightly imports, so we're running a patched copy in the meantime; one contributor approved it on 12 September, but Sven, the maintainer who owns that module, hasn't replied to my pings on 18 and 25 September. The project's contributing guide says to raise PRs left unreviewed for two weeks on the core team forum, and I've told Sven in the PR thread that I'm doing that.
cases.reply:
Title: Review needed: PR #612, crash on empty header rows
Hi core team, I'm raising this under the contributing guide's two-week rule. PR #612, opened on 8 September, fixes a crash when a CSV file has an empty header row, and one contributor approved it on 12 September. I pinged Sven, who owns that module, on 18 and 25 September, and I've let him know in the PR thread that I'm posting here. The crash hits about 30 of our nightly imports, so we're running a patched copy until it's merged. Could someone with merge rights review it, or tell me what's blocking it, by Friday 9 October? I'm happy to make any changes needed.
cases.note: In a volunteer project there's no boss: use the project's own escalation route, tell the maintainer first, and ask for a review or the blocker, not a guaranteed merge.

cases.situation: 我是新入职两周的财务分析师孙悦，ERP系统权限到现在还没开通。9月21日提了IT工单IT-3087，9月24日和29日跟负责的IT同事小张确认过，都说在排队。我10月12日周一起要独立做月结，没权限就做不了；领导陈经理让我直接找IT主管杜经理，我也已经跟小张说了。
cases.reply: 杜经理您好，我是财务部新入职的孙悦，想请您帮忙推动一下我的ERP系统权限。9月21日我提了IT工单IT-3087，9月24日和29日跟负责的小张确认过，都说还在排队；我已经跟小张说了会联系您，陈经理也知道。我从10月12日（周一）起要独立做月结，没有ERP权限就没法开展。能否请您在10月9日（周五）前安排开通，或者告诉我还缺哪些审批？谢谢！
cases.note: 新人找IT主管也按升级的写法：工单号、跟进过的日期、截止日和一个请求，并且先跟经手的同事打招呼。
